Dardo, saw NetBrain just rolled Agentic NetOps live, Agent Skills, AI Path Doctor, and an MCP Server.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings NetBrain needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how NetBrain's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise network-software vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise network motion? I'll tailor it to NetBrain either way.
